snippet.title: The Horde Wants You Dead | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
*** THE HORDE WANTS YOU DEAD demo is out now on Steam! ***

Take on the horde by yourself or grab some friends and try to survive!

THE HORDE WANTS YOU DEAD is a casual, top-down shooter with 4-player online co-op. Ambushed by an angry horde, you and your friends face a fight for survival against thousands of relentless enemies!

Coming soon to Steam!  Download the demo and wishlist here: https://s.team/a/3552820
